purpose: Discover repeatable agent-facing repository development utilities through governed project rules.

utilities.title: Plan the smallest sufficient Docker verification contour
utilities.purpose: Select tests from changed files, dependency rules, risk level, and release boundaries.
constraints: The planner selects tests; execution remains in the Docker verification contour.
utilities.risk: An incomplete dependency map can under-select tests, so shared or unknown changes escalate conservatively.
utilities.verification: Review reasons and escalation level before running the returned Docker command.

utilities.title: Run pytest in the isolated Docker test contour
utilities.purpose: Execute the selected pytest contour without touching working project databases.
constraints: Do not replace this with host pytest.
Use the contour selected by verification.plan unless a release gate or operator request requires broader coverage.
utilities.risk: A full-suite run is expensive and can obscure relevant failures with unrelated baseline noise.
utilities.verification: Report selected tests, new failures, and unchanged registered baseline failures separately.

utilities.title: Classify pytest failures against the governed baseline registry
utilities.purpose: Separate new regressions from exact, reviewed, non-expired known failures.
constraints: Only exact pytest node ids can match baseline entries.
Expired or invalid entries never suppress a failure.
utilities.risk: Broad patterns or stale entries can hide regressions and are rejected.
utilities.verification: The report lists new, registered, expired, and invalid baseline failures separately.

utilities.title: Validate public release inputs and Docker context
utilities.purpose: Run read-only public release readiness checks before any build or push.
utilities.risk: Passing checks do not authorize publishing.

utilities.title: Build and publish immutable Docker Hub images
utilities.purpose: Build and push public latest and immutable git-SHA Docker image tags.
constraints: Publish only committed and synchronized work.
The production image must pass release.first_run before any push.
utilities.risk: Pushes public mutable and immutable image tags to Docker Hub.
utilities.verification: Inspect remote digest and smoke-test the immutable git-SHA image in an isolated contour.

utilities.title: Publish the Docker Hub repository overview
utilities.purpose: Synchronize the governed Docker Hub overview document with the public repository.
utilities.verification: Confirm Docker Hub reports the updated overview.

utilities.title: Audit production image first-run experience
utilities.purpose: Start a production image without repository mounts, verify readiness and dependency diagnostics, and run the canonical MCP smoke.
constraints: The audit uses isolated in-memory Qdrant and never points at working project stores.
Run before publishing and repeat against the immutable remote image after pull.
utilities.risk: Starts a temporary local Docker container and binds a random loopback port.
utilities.verification: Health, dependency diagnostics, no-mount isolation, and MCP smoke all pass; the temporary container is removed.

utilities.title: Run isolated remote MCP end-to-end verification
utilities.purpose: Verify the remote MCP transport and public tool flow in temporary Docker services.
constraints: Do not point it at the working SQLite or Qdrant stores.
utilities.risk: Builds and starts temporary Docker services.
utilities.verification: The remote MCP E2E script exits successfully and removes temporary services.
